title: Release of Zulrah & Toxic Blowpipe
summary: Toxic Blowpipe is introduced as a rare drop from Zulrah (Tanzanite Fang).
details: Fires darts at rapid 2-tick speed (1.2 seconds in PvM) with +60 Ranged Attack bonus and +40 Ranged Strength when loaded with Dragon Darts. Scales with all dart types and inflicts Venom.
quote: The Toxic Blowpipe is designed to be a high-end ranged weapon that consumes Zulrah scales and darts to deliver lethal venomous barrages.

title: PvP Speed Reduction (3-tick in PvP)
summary: Toxic Blowpipe attack speed was reduced to 3-ticks (1.8s) when attacking other players.
details: In PvP combat, the 2-tick attack speed combined with Dragon Darts made prayer switches impossible and out-damaged entire food combos. Attack speed in PvP was nerfed to standard 3-tick speed.

title: The Historic 2021 Great Equipment Rebalance
summary: Toxic Blowpipe's base stats slashed from +60 Ranged Attack to +30, and dart scaling completely reworked.
details: After 6 years of trivializing nearly every high-defense boss in OSRS, Jagex cut the base accuracy in half (+60 down to +30) and reduced dart ranged strength across Bronze through Rune, while buffing Dragon & Amethyst darts and introducing Bow of Faerdhinen (BowFa) to fill the high-defense void.
quote: The Blowpipe in its current state suppresses almost all other ranged weapons from ever having a niche. We need room for new weapons to breathe.
quoteAuthor: Mod Kieren & Mod Elena, Equipment Rebalance Blog
before: +60 Ranged Attack, +40 Ranged Strength with Dragon Darts (overpowers all monsters)
after: +30 Ranged Attack, +35 Ranged Strength (specialized for low-defense targets)

title: Amethyst Dart Release & Tuning
summary: Amethyst Darts released to provide non-degrading high tier ammo for Blowpipe users.
details: With Rune darts nerfed and Dragon darts too expensive for casual Slayer, 89 Fletching Amethyst Darts provided +28 ranged strength, making them the new standard PvM ammo.

title: Zulrah Released — 'The Money Snake'
summary: Zulrah emerges in the Poison Waste with four color rotations and a massive resource drop table.
details: Drops 100 Magic logs, 100 Raw Sharks, 250 Mahogany Planks, 20 Dragon Med Helms, and Tanzanite/Magic fangs. Instantly becomes the most profitable solo method in the game at 2.5m - 3.5m GP/hr.

title: Drop Table Nerf #1 & Teleport Scrolls
summary: Zul-andra teleport scroll quantity dropped from 20 per drop to 1-4, and Magic logs adjusted.
details: Teleport scrolls were initially flooding the game at 20 scrolls per standard drop, making banking instant and costless.

title: The Great 2017 Zulrah Economy Nerf
summary: Zulrah's resource drops reduced by ~30% across the board; raw sharks, magic logs, and runite ore replaced or slashed.
details: Jagex addressed long-term inflation and the devaluation of gathering skills (Woodcutting, Fishing, Mining). Raw sharks dropped from 100 to 35, Magic logs replaced by Swamp tar and grapes.
quote: Zulrah has been overly dominant on gathering skills. We want high-level resource gathering to come from skills, not a single repeatable snake.

title: Unique Dismantle Feature
summary: Players can now dismantle duplicate Zulrah uniques (Blowpipe, Serp Helm, Magic Fang) for 20,000 Zulrah Scales.
details: Stabilized the price floor of Tanzanite Fangs and Serpentine Helms by tying their minimum value directly to the economy of Zulrah scales.

title: Release in Tombs of Amascut
summary: Osmumten's Fang introduced as a rare reward from Raids 3: Tombs of Amascut.
details: Features a unique double-accuracy roll mechanism: on every attack, two accuracy rolls are made, and the higher roll is used. Additionally, damage rolls between 15% and 85% of maximum hit.

title: Bugfix: Outside-Raid Double Accuracy Roll
summary: Fang's secondary roll was inadvertently rolling against 0 defense on certain NPCs outside ToA.
details: A code quirk caused the secondary accuracy roll to check against a target's flat defense level rather than full defense roll outside ToA. Fixing this reduced its extreme over-performance at Corporeal Beast and Nex.

title: The Slash Accuracy Nerf & Project Rebalance
summary: Osmumten's Fang loses its double-accuracy roll when using the Slash attack style.
details: Fang was so absurdly accurate on Slash that it beat dedicated Slash weapons like the Blade of Saeldor and Soulreaper Axe at Vardorvis and Duke Sucellus. Jagex restricted double-accuracy strictly to Stab style.
before: Double-accuracy roll on both Stab AND Slash attack styles.
after: Double-accuracy roll ONLY applies to Stab style. Slash acts as a normal melee weapon.
quote: The Fang was designed as an iconic Desert stab weapon. Allowing it to outclass the Scythe, Saeldor, and Soulreaper Axe on Slash was an oversight.

title: Wilderness Boss Rework & Voidwaker Launch
summary: Voidwaker introduced as an assembled weapon from Callisto, Venenatis, and Vet'ion pieces.
details: Requires the Voidwaker Blade, Gem, and Hilt. Special attack 'Disrupt' costs 50% spec, hits 100% guaranteed magic damage (50-150% max hit), ignoring target defense entirely.

title: The Guaranteed-Hit Spec Debate & Community Poll
summary: Jagex proposed removing guaranteed accuracy in PvM/PvP, resulting in massive community pushback.
details: After polling, Jagex preserved its guaranteed spec in PvP/PvM but rebalanced defense considerations in future bosses to prevent trivialization.

title: Chambers of Xeric Launch
summary: OSRS's first ever raid opens beneath Mount Quidamortem with the Great Olm.
details: Introduced Twisted Bow, Ancestral Robes, Dragon Claws, Dinh's Bulwark, and Kodai Wand. Supported dynamic team scaling up to 100 players.

title: Private Storage & Layout Scouter Improvements
summary: Introduced personal shared storage chests and potion decanting inside the raid.

title: Chambers of Xeric 2023 Grand Overhaul
summary: Scouting officially revolutionized: custom raid layout selection, Olm hand transitions fixed, Ice Demon rekindling speedup.
details: Players no longer had to leave and rejoin dozens of times to find a good room layout. Tightened point scaling and removed annoying dead-time.
quote: We want Chambers of Xeric to feel like modern OSRS raiding without losing the nostalgic discovery of 2017.

title: The Inferno Arena Opens in Mor Ul Rek
summary: TzHaar Inferno unlocks for players who sacrifice a Fire Cape.
details: 69 brutal waves featuring Nibblers, Jal-Ak, Jal-ImKot, Jal-Zek, 3 Jads at once on Wave 68, and TzKal-Zuk with his roving stone shield.

title: Woox Achieves World-First Infernal Cape
summary: Legendary player Woox completes the Inferno live on Twitch without a Twisted Bow, taking over 2 hours in front of 60,000 viewers.

title: Launch of Great Kourend Continent
summary: OSRS's first brand new continent opens with 5 houses: Arceuus, Hosidius, Lovakengj, Piscarilius, and Shayzien.
details: Launched with a rigid grid-like layout, massive empty walkways, and a 0-100% favor system for each house.

title: GentleTractor's Kourend Redesign Implemented
summary: Jagex rebuilt Hosidius and Shayzien based on legendary Reddit redesign proposals by player 'GentleTractor'.
details: Transformed artificial straight roads into winding rivers, natural farmlands, authentic medieval buildings, and dense foliage.

title: Complete Removal of Kourend Favor System
summary: The tedious 100% house favor grind was permanently deleted from the game.
details: House activities, quests, and mini-games now unlock directly based on quest completions and skill levels rather than house favor grinding.

title: Nightmare Zone Launch Enables 6-Hour AFK Melee
summary: Full Guthan's set effect in NMZ Rumble allows players to survive 6 hours without touching the keyboard.

title: The Historic 6-Hour AFK Patch (The '20-Minute Timer')
summary: Jagex implements a 20-minute auto-retaliate cutoff timer, ending 2.5 years of 6-hour sleeping combat gains.
details: After years of heated debate, poll failures, and community uproar, Jagex stepped in with an integrity fix: players stop attacking back after 20 minutes of no manual input.
quote: We have introduced a 20-minute interaction timer to ensure Old School RuneScape combat requires active engagement.

title: Revenant Caves Release with 100x Statuette Drop Glitch
summary: Revenant Caves open in Level 17-40 Wilderness with multi-combat ghost monsters.
details: Due to a code bug, 100x ancient statuettes dropped simultaneously, pumping hundreds of millions of GP into the game within hours before a rapid hotfix.

title: Caves Converted to Singles-Plus & 100k Entrance Fee
summary: Multi-combat removed from Revenant Caves to dismantle massive real-money protection clan syndicates.
details: Major multi-combat PK clans had locked down every world and charged players $50-$100/week for safe farming. Jagex converted the entire dungeon to Singles-Plus and added a 100k GP entry fee.

title: Lizardman Shamans & DWH Introduced
summary: Dragon Warhammer released with 50% spec cost, draining target's current defense by 30% on successful hit.
details: Dropped at a brutal 1/5,000 drop rate from Lizardman Shamans in Kourend, becoming an essential requirement for Corp, CoX, and ToB.

title: Drop Rate Buffed to 1/3,000 in Project Rebalance
summary: After 8 years at 1/5,000, Jagex reduced the grind by 40%, buffing the drop rate to 1/3,000.
details: A celebrated relief for Ironman players who previously had to kill thousands of Shamans for months just to participate in endgame bossing.

title: Theatre of Blood Release
summary: Scythe of Vitur introduced as the ultra-rare megarare weapon of Theatre of Blood.
details: Requires 100 Blood Runes and 1 Vial of Blood per 100 swings. Attacks in a 3x3 sweep hitting up to 3 separate damage splats against large targets (100% / 50% / 25%).

title: Accuracy Buff & Charge Cost Rework
summary: Scythe receives +15 Slash accuracy and +30 to other styles, plus reduced blood charge costs.
details: Helped the Scythe reclaim its rightful spot as the king of multi-tile melee bossing without bank-draining upkeep.

title: Twisted Bow Introduced in Chambers of Xeric
summary: The Twisted Bow debuts as the ultra-rare unique from Raids 1.
details: Its damage and accuracy scale logarithmically based on the magic level of the targeted monster (capped at 250 in standard PvM and 350 in CoX).

title: The Infamous 'T-Bow Bush' Spawn Glitch & Server Rollback
summary: A misplaced item spawn coordinate created a respawning Twisted Bow on the ground near the Farming Guild in Kourend.
details: Following a game update, an errant ground spawn caused 1.2 billion GP Twisted Bows to spawn continuously in a bush outside the Farming Guild. Players looted thousands of bows and traded them before Jagex shut down the servers and performed the first full game rollback in OSRS history.
quote: We apologize sincerely for the rollback. An accidental object spawn ID placed a Twisted Bow on a standard bush tile outside the Farming Guild.
quoteAuthor: Mod Ash & Old School Team Announcement

title: Occult Necklace Release
summary: Introduced alongside the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil boss with +10% Magic Damage.
details: Requires 93 Slayer to kill Smoke Devils. Provided the single largest magic damage boost in the game for just 800k GP for a full decade.

title: Project Rebalance: Occult Nerf & Magic Power Redistribution
summary: Occult Necklace magic damage cut from +10% down to +4%; remaining 6% redistributed into Ancestral, Virtus, Infinity, and Chaos Gauntlets.
details: Jagex solved the decade-old anomaly where a 700k necklace gave 5x more magic damage than a 300M GP Ancestral robe set, creating a proper progression curve across all magic armour tiers.
before: +10% Magic Damage on a single 700k necklace (overshadowed all robe sets)
after: +4% Magic Damage on Occult, with +1% to +2% added to helmets, boots, and mid-game sets

title: Fortis Colosseum & Dizana's Quiver Launch
summary: 12 intense modifier-based combat waves culminating in battle with Sol Heredit.
details: Rewards the Best-in-Slot Ranged Cape (Dizana's Quiver) with +28 Ranged Attack, +2 Ranged Strength, and dual-ammo pouch capability.

title: Old School RuneScape Official Launch
summary: Old School RuneScape launches from an August 10, 2007 server backup following 446,605 player poll votes.
details: Starting with just 3 developers (Mod Ash, Mod Mat K, Mod Reach), the game revived classic RuneScape without the Evolution of Combat or microtransactions.
quote: Today we turn back the clock. Old School RuneScape is officially live!
quoteAuthor: Mod Mat K & Jagex Launch Post

title: God Wars Dungeon Reintroduced
summary: General Graardor, Kree'arra, Commander Zilyana, and K'ril Tsutsaroth return to Gielinor.
details: Brought back the Bandos, Armadyl, Saradomin, and Zamorak Godswords, Bandos Chestplate, Tassets, and Armadyl armour.

title: Corporeal Beast & Spirit Shields Launch
summary: The Corporeal Beast cave opens in the Wilderness with 2,000 HP and 50% damage reduction against non-spear weapons.
details: Introduced the Elysian Spirit Shield (17.5% damage reduction), Spectral Spirit Shield, and Arcane Spirit Shield.

title: Monkey Madness II & Demonic Gorillas
summary: OSRS's first grandmaster quest releases alongside Demonic Gorillas, Zenyte jewelry, and Heavy Ballistas.
details: Introduced the Amulet of Torture, Necklace of Anguish, Tormented Bracelet, and Ring of Suffering.

title: Wintertodt Released in Northern Kourend
summary: Wintertodt launches, transforming 99 Firemaking into an interactive team activity with supply crates.
details: Introduced the Pyromancer outfit, Phoenix pet, and Tome of Fire with +50% fire spell damage.

title: Dragon Slayer II & Vorkath Launch
summary: Vorkath emerges on the frozen island of Ungael alongside Ava's Assembler and Dragon Crossbows.
details: Vorkath cemented itself as the premier repeatable solo boss in OSRS, dropping Vorkath's Head for Ava's Assembler.

title: Song of the Elves & The Corrupted Gauntlet
summary: The crystal city of Prifddinas opens with The Gauntlet, Zalcano, and Blade of Saeldor.
details: Introduced pure solo test The Corrupted Gauntlet (Hunllef) requiring zero gear input and rewarding Enhanced Crystal Weapon Seeds.

title: The Nightmare of Ashihama Released in Slepe
summary: The Nightmare opens beneath Morytania dropping Inquisitor's Armour and Nightmare Staff Orbs.
details: Introduced Harmonised, Eldritch, and Volatile Orbs, plus the iconic Inquisitor's Crush bonus armour set.

title: Bow of Faerdhinen (BowFa) & Crystal Armour Buff
summary: BowFa is crafted from Enhanced Crystal Weapon Seeds, offering high accuracy for mid-to-endgame PvM.
details: When paired with full Crystal Armour (+15% damage, +30% accuracy), BowFa solved the post-Blowpipe nerf bossing progression.

title: Nex Returns to the Ancient Prison
summary: Nex releases in the God Wars Dungeon dropping Torva Armour, Zaryte Vambraces, and Zaryte Crossbow.
details: Torva armour replaced Bandos as the best-in-slot melee strength armour set for the first time in 9 years.

title: Guardians of the Rift (GotR) Overhaul
summary: GotR revitalizes Runecrafting, introducing the Raiments of the Eye set with +60% extra runes per craft.
details: Turned the most hated slow skill into a bustling, interactive cooperative experience.

title: Tombs of Amascut & Tumeken's Shadow Launch
summary: ToA launches with the Invocation system, Tumeken's Shadow, Osmumten's Fang, and Masori Armour.
details: Tumeken's Shadow tripled magic damage, while Invocations allowed scaling raid difficulty from Entry (0) to Expert (500+).

title: Desert Treasure II: Four Grandmaster Bosses
summary: Duke Sucellus, Vardorvis, The Leviathan, and The Whisperer release alongside Virtus Robes & Soulreaper Axe.
details: Introduced the ancient ring upgrades (Bellator, Magus, Ultor, Venator) and 4 distinct solo bosses with unique drop protection mechanics.

title: Chambers of Xeric Grand Quality of Life Overhaul
summary: Scouting officially solved: custom layout selection, Olm hand transitions, and Ice Demon rekindling speedup.
details: Players no longer had to leave and rejoin dozens of times to find an Olm room layout.

title: Araxxor & Noxious Halberd Launch
summary: The Level 92 Slayer spider boss Araxxor emerges in Varlamore Part 2.
details: Drops the Noxious Halberd (2-tile reach 5-tick crush/slash weapon) and Amulet of Rancour (best-in-slot melee amulet succeeding Amulet of Torture).

title: Official OSRS HD Graphics Client Launch
summary: Jagex launches the official native high-definition lighting, atmospheric weather, and enhanced textures client.
details: Dynamic real-time lighting, sunshafts, water reflections, and expanded draw distance across all of Gielinor.

title: Sailing: The First New Skill in OSRS History
summary: Sailing launches after passing community poll with 71.9% approval, unlocking custom player-built ships and deep ocean exploration.
details: Navigate the open seas, chart lost archipelagos, engage in naval monster combat against the Leviathans of the deep, and salvage sunken treasure galleons.
quote: After 13 years of history, the oceans of Gielinor are finally open to every adventurer.
quoteAuthor: Mod Elena, Mod Husky & Sailing Team
